entries.hackNote: Frame 02 is hack-forced: `isSwapSend` was temporarily relaxed to fire on any swap action so an ordinary ChangeNow swap would take the new branch, because no transaction on this host carries a stamped `swapType` and a fresh Houdini quote is impossible without HOUDINI_INIT credentials. The hack was reverted and the tree is clean at e1f42eb4d. Frame 02 proves the retitled row renders; it does NOT prove the swapType trigger, which the unit tests cover.
